Our Affiliate Program

Greetings and welcome to the T-Shirt Bakery Affiliate Program. We are thrilled that you're exploring the possibility of partnering with us.

BECOME A
T-SHIRT BAKERY AFFILIATE

Join our referral scheme to

earn a commission

on orders your audience makes.
SIGNUP AND START EARNING

Who Are We: 

At T-Shirt Bakery, we view every piece of clothing as a canvas for self-expression. Our mission is to empower individuals, businesses, and communities to wear their stories, passions, and creativity proudly. We're dedicated to upholding the highest quality standards in every print, utilising innovative techniques that align with our deep-rooted sustainability values. From eco-friendly inks to responsible production processes, we prioritise both the quality of your garment and the well-being of our planet.

What We Do: 

T-Shirt Bakery is a distinguished UK print-on-demand supplier and order fulfilment company, offering an extensive catalogue featuring over a hundred clothing lines to cater to a broad spectrum of customer requirements. Our online product designer simplifies the ordering process, enabling customers to place their orders quickly and efficiently, allowing our valued affiliates to maximise their commission.
 

BECAUSE AN AFFILIATE


Why Join our Affiliate Program?

We offer a fantastic opportunity for affiliates to partner with us and earn lucrative commissions while promoting our unique and sustainable print-on-demand supplier. Here's why you should consider becoming a part of our affiliate family:

10% Commission

For all orders placed through your personal referral link. (Excludes taxes and shipping).

 Receive payments

for up to 9 months.

You will receive payments for each unique customer for nine months.

Get Paid Every 30 days

You will get paid at the end of each month, with a minimum payout of £30.

Branded Media Pack

Our affiliate media pack. Everything you will need, from promotional videos to social media imagery.
MEDIA PACK DOWNLOAD
 
 
 

How it Works

Share your link

Begin by sharing your unique link. You can do this on your website, in a Facebook group, or directly with a merchant or a friend.

Your link is clicked

When someone, like a merchant, follows your link and makes a purchase, you will receive a commission for up to 9 months for every purchase the merchant/customer places.

An order is placed

After the referred account places an order manually or through an integrated platform, the T-Shirt Bakery tracks and fulfils it.

You get commission

You earn a commission when the order is attributed to your affiliate account. This commission amounts to 10% of the fulfilment price, excluding Tax and shipping costs.

You get paid

You will receive a payment monthly once your account balance accumulates to £30. Payments are transferred directly to your PayPal account.
SIGNUP NOW


Why Affiliates Trust Us:

With a commitment to Sustainability, Quality Excellence, Speedy Turnarounds, Competitive Rates, and Worldwide Shipping. Discover the Foundations of Trust in Our Affiliate Program.

1. Sustainability
and Eco Values:

We steadfastly commit to sustainability and ethical sourcing. Our partnership with Stanley/Stella, renowned as the industry's most sustainable and eco-friendly clothing brand, underscores our dedication to these values. Stanley/Stella is also a vegan-friendly brand, ensuring that none of our dyes or elements have been tested on animals.

2. Quality before Quantity:

Prioritising quality in our clothing printing is of utmost importance. This approach not only elevates our brand standing but also ensures customer satisfaction. Moreover, it aligns with our profitability and sustainability objectives by minimising errors and the need for reprints. To achieve top-tier print quality, we employ cutting-edge Kornit Atlas MAX printers.

3. Fast Turnaround:

Our typical dispatch time is 2-5 days, and the importance of a swift turnaround cannot be overstated. Our clients often need quick solutions for promotions, events, or fashion trends. Timely delivery is crucial for client satisfaction and loyalty. We prioritize both quality and efficiency, making us a trusted brand in our industry.

4. Low Rates &
Worldwide Shipping:

Affiliates, boost your earnings with our Low Rates & Worldwide Shipping. Our competitive pricing and global reach ensure you can market our products to a broad audience, maximizing your commission potential. Join our program now and tap into a world of opportunities!
BECOME AN AFFILIATE TODAY
term_and_condition:
Welcome to T-Shirt Bakery! Thanks for joining our Affiliate program.

These following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use product or service from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.

 

1. Approve or Reject of the Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.

 

2. Affiliate Links and Coupon

Affiliate link is automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later they click on yours, yours is the one that counts.

Affiliate might or might not be assigned to one coupon code with details and usage clarified on Dashboard. If customer both click on the affiliate link and use coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you’re not assigned a branded coupon, then you’re not allowed to promote the coupon.

Affiliate may also advertise merchant website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram,... or offline classified channel ads, magazines, and newspapers.

 

3. Commissions and payment

Refer any customer to make a purchase on our website, you will get a commission amount which is calculated based on Commission structure. Commission amount is dependent on order value and not including extra fee (tax, shipping cost,...).

For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details on Settings. Payment schedule will be notified on Affiliate Guide page.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy which gives merchant the right to review each and every referral order. Status of commission if displayed in Commission tab, any paid commission will be listed on Payment tab. Transactions that result in charge backs or refunds will not be paid out.

 

4. Marketing tool

We may share promotion media such as banner, logo or specific collection promotion to you through Marketing tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code in order to share on affiliate channels.

 

5. Network

If Network tab is activated, affiliate can invite others to become their downline affiliate. If any downline affiliate brings order to merchant shop, upline affiliate will also get network commission which depends on merchant settings.

To invite other affiliates into the system, share network link and any other affiliate who click on that link and sign up will become a downline affiliate.

 

6. Cookie

We use a cookie to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to be using cookies for us to track them.

If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies then we can't track them so can't pay earnings on that person's activity.

Cookies day is said on the Affiliate registration form. The tracking day will start from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate’s link or use the coupon. Within the cookie time, every order made by this customer at merchant website will automatically result in commissions to the affiliate (There’s no need for the customer to click on the affiliate link then).

 

7. Removal from Referral Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: support@tshirtbakery.co.uk.

 

Go forward and refer!

We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document.

We wish you all the very best. You can always re-visit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future and if you have any questions you can send email to support@tshirtbakery.co.uk for support.
